chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū Baṣīr, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about the sick person who loses consciousness and then regains awareness: how does he make up his salat (prayer)? He said: He makes up the salat (prayer) whose time he had reached.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: to have reached or lived to encounter
key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the specific salat (prayer) to be made up
key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.يَقْضِي: to make up an obligatory act after its time

ai.seo_question: Which prayers must a person make up after regaining consciousness from illness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a sick person who faints and then regains consciousness. It states that he must make up only the salat (prayer) whose time he had lived to reach, indicating a limit to the obligation of qaḍāʾ for one who was unconscious.
